test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) He entered the complete address of where he was going into the search bar.
(2) The navigation system then directed him with turn-by-turn instructions while he drove.
(3) Having considered the alternatives, he chose the one with the shortest estimated duration.
(4) He turned on his GPS and waited for the device to gain a signal from the satellites.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sequence needs to follow a logical flow of actions, starting with turning on the GPS and ending with receiving directions.
 
• **Sentence 4** is the first step, as it describes turning on the GPS and waiting for the device to gain a signal.
 
• **Sentence 1** follows, where the user enters the complete address into the search bar.
 
• **Sentence 3** comes next, as it involves selecting the route with the shortest estimated duration.
 
• **Sentence 2** is the final step, where the navigation system provides turn-by-turn instructions while driving.
 
• The correct sequence is **4 - 1 - 3 - 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This type of question requires analyzing the logical sequence of events to maintain coherence.
 
• Understanding the context of each sentence is crucial to identify the order.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"He turned on his GPS and waited for the device to gain a signal from the satellites. He entered the complete address of where he was going into the search bar. Having considered the alternatives, he chose the one with the shortest estimated duration. The navigation system then directed him with turn-by-turn instructions while he drove."</div
